description: The drone software technician will collaborate with stakeholders to document functional and non-functional requirements, create architectural diagrams that outline software structure, and design algorithms for navigation and flight control. . The technician will utilize simulation tools to test algorithms and validate software performance in controlled environments before conducting real-world flight tests. Thorough documentation of code and preparing software for deployment will also be key responsibilities, alongside updating it based on user feedback and technological advancements.
awardingBodyName: Nasscom  National Association of Software and Service Companies
